build.summary:
Built most of pci-bench-measure-and-plan inside its eight listed files. One gap remains: the bench screen (src/ui/sections/PciBench.tsx), which this package may not edit, still shows its own slice read-out. That read-out includes EEM area and plaque burden, so the exam-mode criterion is only partly met until that file is changed.

What was built:
- **Engine (src/simulation/pciBench.ts).** Each lesion now states a goal and a patient. The modality reasons come from pm-imaging-when-which. Lesions can also carry extra plaques, a piecewise EEM, two branch pullbacks that share the left main segment, and an ostium with the aorta proximal to it. Frames in the aorta show an aortic lumen wider than the field of view. With OCT, frames from the aorta through the first 5 mm past the ostium are uncleared blood (benchFrameAt reports region and measurability). The landing-zone truth now also excludes the lipid pool. A sizing function applies Brilakis's distal-reference rules (lumen + 0.25 mm or EEM − 0.25 mm, read both ways the module describes).
- **Consequences in deploy().** An edge on lipid or on plaque burden over 50% dissects once stretched. A stent larger than the distal reference allows dissects the distal edge. OCT runs add their flush to imagingContrastMl, using the module's 4 mL/s × 4 s for the left system and 3 × 3 for the RCA. The new options argument is optional, so existing callers are unchanged.
- **Five new presets.** ostial-lm-ivus, distal-lm-two-branch, aorto-ostial-rca, ckd-ivus (age 76, eGFR 24, from the module) and acs-culprit-oct are in MEASURE_LESIONS. They are kept out of BENCH_LESIONS because core.launch.ts and its test require the picker list to stay exactly as it is. BENCH_BY_ID holds both lists, so launchBench opens the new presets.
- **Grading (src/simulation/bench/measure.ts).** gradeModality, planTruth, gradePlan, exactPlan and lmSegmentCheck. Left main thresholds: IVUS 6.0 mm², or 4.5 mm² with the population toggle; OCT 5.4 mm². Physiology is accepted in the 4.5–6.0 grey zone. Segment targets after stenting are 5, 6, 7 and 8 mm², and the calcium score follows Fujino. The module also holds the pure geometry the tools use (polygon area, mean diameter, arc, frame and marker snapping).
- **Measuring tools (src/ui/imaging/MeasureTools.tsx).** Trace, caliper, arc protractor and thickness caliper, with thickness refused on IVUS. Pullback markers snap to frames and to each other and give the length. The tools only report what the learner measured, so they are usable in the PCI lab as well.
- **Plan form (src/ui/bench/PlanForm.tsx).** The form, a zustand plan store per lesion, a review table and the grey-zone hand-off. The hand-off is offered only when the learner's own MLA falls in the IVUS grey zone, and it calls openSim('physiology', {scenario:'lm-intermediate'}).
- **Image step (src/ui/bench/ImagePanel.tsx).** Shows the goal and patient, then a reason picker and the commitment to a modality. Then come pullback runs per branch, the operator-visible contrast count for OCT, the measuring workspace with an uncleared-blood overlay for OCT, and the plan. The old pre-PCI truth table is gone. The comparison with the frames appears after entry only in guided mode; guided and exam block moving on until the plan is entered.
- **Debrief (src/ui/bench/AssessPanel.tsx).** Adds the modality grade and what a wrong choice cost, the plan graded against the frames, imaging contrast, and the left main segment table.
- **Launch file.** src/content/lab/presets/pci-bench/measure.launch.ts lists all five presets under pm-imaging-when-which, pm-imaging-planning and pm-imaging-optimisation, plus left main, ostial and ACS lessons.

Recalibration: existing pciBench, ivus, benchTips and imaging tests pass unchanged. In one existing benchTips.scenario test the stent edge now dissects at any stretch rather than above 1.1× the lumen; that test already expected a dissection.

outOfScope: src/ui/sections/PciBench.tsx (owned by pci-bench-imaging-unify, not in this package's list). The package's screen behaviour needs these edits: (1) pass lesion={l} and mode={run.mode} to <ImagePanel>. Without them the panel cannot show the goal and patient before the modality is chosen, and it treats every run as unguided. (2) Gate the slice read-out rows (EEM area, Lumen area, Plaque burden, Calcium here; lines ~281-288) so they show only when run.mode === 'guided' and useBenchPlanStore.getState().records[l.id]?.submitted is set. In supervised, independent and exam modes hide them until the debrief. This is what the browser exam-mode criterion needs. (3) Build the main frame with benchFrameAt(l, x, modality, branch) instead of ivusFrame(benchIvusContext(...)), so aorta and uncleared OCT frames read 'not measurable'. Add a branch selector for lesions with branches (benchPullbacks). (4) Pass { imagingRuns: record.runs.length + 1 } to deploy(). (5) In restart() call useBenchPlanStore.getState().reset(lesionId). (6) In finish() log the plan's gradePlan items as decisions (lessonId pm-imaging-planning). Optionally expose the plan on __lab.bench. (7) If wanted, add MEASURE_LESIONS to the lesion picker, titled from measure.launch.ts. Today they open only by launch; a launched preset is not among the picker's options.

It should use ALL_BENCH_LESIONS (exported from pciBench.ts) so the presets' aorto-ostial-lesion event is declared. build.notes:
Snapshot: datasets/tmp/wp-snapshots/pci-bench-measure-and-plan/ holds pciBench.ts, ImagePanel.tsx and AssessPanel.tsx as they were. The other five listed files are new. .started is created. No file outside the list was edited apart from the three new test files.

Design decisions:
- **Presets kept out of BENCH_LESIONS.** benchTips.scenario.test.ts (another package's file) requires core.launch.ts scenarios to equal BENCH_LESIONS exactly, and ivus.test.ts iterates BENCH_LESIONS. The five presets therefore live in MEASURE_LESIONS, with ALL_BENCH_LESIONS and BENCH_BY_ID covering both.
- **Goals added to the six existing lesions.** These are data only, no geometry change.
- **preImaging gains `lesionId`.** It now starts at the ostium for ostial lesions, uses the distal reference in place of the missing proximal reference there, and excludes the lipid pool from landing zones. Existing lesions without lipid are unchanged.
- **Proximal-reference rule uses nominal diameter.** deploy() judges proximal sizing on the stent's nominal diameter (the sizing decision), so a correctly sized 3.5 mm stent deployed at 12 atm (3.75 mm on the catalogue chart) does not trigger it.
- **Plan in a zustand store (useBenchPlanStore in PlanForm.tsx).** The image step and the debrief are separate components, and PciBench.tsx cannot be changed to carry the plan between them. Components also read getState() as a fallback so a server render and the first render after a commit see the record.
- **Reason required only in guided and exam.** The modality reason is required before committing only in those modes, following the forms-block-only-in-guided-and-exam rule; in other modes it is optional.

Sources: every quoted threshold and rule cites src/content/manual/pci-manual/15-imaging.ts (pm-imaging-when-which, pm-imaging-oct, pm-imaging-planning, pm-imaging-optimisation; Brilakis and Oxford locations as stated there).

Known limitation: a relaunch into the same lesion with the same modality preset keeps that lesion's earlier plan record until restart() resets the store, which needs the PciBench.tsx edit above.

findings.where: src/simulation/pciBench.ts deploy() (profile, proxEdgePB, maxMalapposition) for presets with `ostial` (ostial-lm-ivus, aorto-ostial-rca)
findings.problem: deploy() does not treat the aorta as aorta, so it penalises the coverage the presets teach. The teaching says to cover the ostium with the stent just protruding into the aorta. Probe (IVUS, nominal pressure, 12 mm stent): on ostial-lm-ivus with a 4.5 mm stent and proxEdge 3 (protruding 1 mm), the portion in the aorta is scored against lumen()=eem() (plaque burden is 0 there), so maxMalapposition is 0.47 mm and the 'Malapposition < 0.4 mm' criterion fails. With proxEdge 4 (exactly at the ostium), proxEdgePB is plaqueBurden(l,4)=0.50, so the 'Plaque burden < 50% at both edges' criterion fails. No position covers the ostium and passes both. aorto-ostial-rca passes malapposition only by chance (0.34 mm). The planTruth/gradePlan proximal landing (the ostium) therefore conflicts with the deploy score.
findings.fix: In deploy(), when l.ostial is set: (a) exclude profile points with inAorta(l, p.x) from the malapposition and expansion inputs (protrusion into the aorta is not malapposition); (b) when x0 <= l.ostial.aortaMm (the ostium is covered), take proxEdgePB as 0, or skip the proximal-edge plaque-burden check and the proximal edgeDiss; (c) when x0 > l.ostial.aortaMm + 0.5, add an 'ostium not covered' event or geographic-miss note. Add a measure.test.ts case: on both ostial presets, a distal-sized stent with proxEdge = aortaMm - 1 that reaches the distal landing zone passes the malapposition and edge criteria, and one starting 1 mm inside the ostium is flagged.

findings.where: src/ui/sections/PciBench.tsx (owned by pci-bench-imaging-unify and later packages; not in this package's list)
findings.problem: The design is wired into the components but not into the screen, so on the live bench most of it is inert. (1) <ImagePanel> gets neither lesion nor mode. With modality null, pre is null and the panel cannot find the lesion, so the goal, the patient and the reason picker are never shown before the choice. reasonId is then always null, so the debrief's 'Reason for the modality' item always fails. With mode undefined, exam and guided blocking does nothing and the guided comparison never appears. (2) The slice read-out (lines ~281-288: EEM area, Lumen area, Plaque burden) still renders in every mode, so the acceptance criterion 'browser: in exam mode no plaque-burden read-out is in the DOM before the plan is submitted' fails. (3) The main frame is built with ivusFrame(benchIvusContext(...)), not benchFrameAt, so aorta and uncleared-OCT frames read as measurable vessel there. (4) canGo('prep') requires only a modality, so the step tabs bypass the 'enter the plan first' block in exam and guided. (5) deploy() is called without imagingRuns, and restart() does not reset useBenchPlanStore, so a relaunch with the same modality keeps the old submitted plan. The disabled form then cannot be re-entered, and in exam the block is already lifted.
findings.fix: Route as a follow-up to the PciBench.tsx owner (or amend the plan to add src/ui/sections/PciBench.tsx to this package). Pass lesion={l} and mode={run.mode} to ImagePanel. Render the slice-read-out rows only when run.mode === 'guided' && useBenchPlanStore.getState().records[l.id]?.submitted, or at step 'optimise'/'assess'. Build the main frame with benchFrameAt(l, x, modality, branch, st, deployed).frame and show 'not measurable' when !lumenMeasurable. In canGo('prep'|'stent'), when run.mode is 'guided' or 'exam', also require records[l.id]?.submitted. Pass {imagingRuns: record.runs.length + 1} to every deploy() call. In restart(), and in load() for a launch, call useBenchPlanStore.getState().reset(lesionId). In finish(), log the gradePlan items as decisions with lessonId pm-imaging-planning. Then add a browser or SSR test of PciBench in exam mode asserting no /plaque burden/i before submit.

findings.problem: The proximal post-dilatation balloon must be 'a larger, shorter balloon chosen from the proximal reference', but postDilSizes is not filtered against the stent. On focal-lad the stent sizes are [3.5] and the post-dilatation sizes are 3.5/3.75/4, so a 3.5 mm NC balloon on a 3.5 mm stent is graded a correct proximal optimisation. long-taper and small-diagonal behave the same way, with overlapping sizes.
findings.fix: In planTruth, keep only postDilSizes greater than Math.max(...stentSizes). In gradePlan, also require pd > plan.stentDiameterMm when a stent is entered. Add a test that focal-lad with postDilMm 3.5 and stentDiameterMm 3.5 fails 'post-dil'.

findings.where: src/simulation/bench/measure.ts gradePlan() 'reason' item (line ~414) with src/ui/bench/ImagePanel.tsx needReason
findings.problem: The reason is optional in supervised and independent modes, as the builder chose, but gradePlan always scores a missing reason as wrong. A learner in those modes loses a point for leaving out an optional field. On the current screen the picker is never shown (see the PciBench.tsx finding), so the item always fails.
findings.fix: Push the 'reason' item only when plan.reasonId is set or the mode requires a reason. Either add an optional `requireReason` to BenchPlan, set from the mode, or leave a null reason ungraded (given 'not stated', not counted in total).

findings.where: src/ui/bench/AssessPanel.tsx (contrast row) vs src/simulation/pciBench.ts deploy() imagingContrastMl
findings.problem: Two inconsistent sources for imaging contrast. AssessPanel counts record.runs.length + 1, while result.imagingContrastMl uses deploy's default of 2 runs. On distal-lm-two-branch with OCT (LAD and LCx runs), the debrief shows 48 mL (3 runs) and the result says 32 mL. Any future consumer of result.imagingContrastMl (metrics, run log) will disagree with the debrief.
findings.fix: Use one source. Have the screen pass imagingRuns (see the PciBench.tsx finding) and have AssessPanel show result.imagingContrastMl, or have AssessPanel ignore result.imagingContrastMl and document that deploy's figure is a default.

findings.problem: The chosen reason is component state and is never reset. After restart() or a lesion change, PciBench keeps ImagePanel mounted with modality null, so the chooser opens with the previous lesion's reason already selected. That pre-fills part of the graded answer in exam mode.
findings.fix: Reset it with useEffect(() => setReasonId(null), [l?.id, modality === null]), or key the chooser by the lesion id and run.

findings.problem: raises.events is derived from BENCH_LESIONS only. The aorto-ostial-lesion event raised at runtime by ostial-lm-ivus and aorto-ostial-rca is therefore not declared to the reachability report, so tips requiring it (e.g. pci-img-ostial-coverage) stay unreachable on the bench. That falls short of the tip integration's 'its event source exports raises for the reachability report'.
findings.fix: Route as a follow-up to the benchTips.ts owner: import ALL_BENCH_LESIONS and use ALL_BENCH_LESIONS.flatMap(benchCaseEvents) in raises.events. Then re-run src/content/lab/reachability.test.ts and update waiting.ts entries that become satisfiable.

findings.where: docs/realism/facts (no file in this package's list)
findings.problem: The rules require a value with no module source to be labelled MODEL PARAMETER in docs/realism/facts. The new MODEL PARAMETERS are labelled only in code: MP_AORTA_LUMEN_MM 30, MP_OCT_OSTIAL_UNCLEARED_MM 5, MP_TWO_BRANCH_POC_MM 12, MEASURE_TOLERANCE, MP_REFERENCE_WINDOW_MM 10, MP_REFERENCE_PB_MARGIN 0.02, MP_LM_SEGMENT_MM, MP_NO_TAPER_MM 0.25, the distal-oversize severity rule, and the geometry of the five presets.
findings.fix: Add a facts entry (e.g. docs/realism/facts/pci-bench-measure.md) listing each constant with its value, its file and line, and 'MODEL PARAMETER (no module source)'. Note that MP_OCT_OSTIAL_UNCLEARED_MM rests on the pm-imaging-when-which pitfall 'failing to clear the ostium' and that the module gives no length. Route it to whichever package owns the facts files, or amend this package's file list.

review.verdict:
Changes requested. The engine and grading work largely implements the design, and the sourcing checks out: the LM thresholds 6.0, 4.5 and 5.4 mm², the 5-6-7-8 segment targets, the Fujino score, the lumen + 0.25 / EEM − 0.25 sizing rule, the OCT flush of 4×4 and 3×3 mL, and eGFR 24 / age 76 are all in src/content/manual/pci-manual/15-imaging.ts. New constants are labelled MODEL PARAMETER in code. Shared engines (criteria.ts, ivus.ts, equipment.ts) are untouched. deploy()'s new options argument is optional, and deploy is only called from the bench.

I ran the package's test files plus the related ones: 10 files, 118 tests passed. These were measure, PlanForm, benchTips.measure, pciBench, benchTips, benchTips.scenario, ivus, imaging, practiceIndex and reachability. `npx tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit` exits 0.

The tests are meaningful, not tautological. They exercise frame truth against lumen() and eem(), the tolerances on both sides, the proximal-reference flag together with the deploy() distal dissection, the lipid-edge dissection, the aorta and uncleared frames, both branch pullbacks with the LCx-only ostial lesion, the population toggle, SSR exam-mode leak checks of the package's components, and the named tips at phase 'imaging'.

My probes with vite-node found the following:
- The plan the frames call for (exactPlan) deploys without dissection on all 11 lesions.
- deploy()'s oversize rule agrees with the graded stent sizes on every lesion.
- gradePlan takes about 0.3 ms per call.
- There are no per-frame allocations in render paths.
- UI uses the design-system classes and British English.
- The only files modified since .started outside the list are access, hypotension, pressure and transducer files, and none of them import the bench, so another package plausibly changed them.

Two blocking problems remain:
1. Ostial presets: deploy() scores the aorta portion of a protruding stent as malapposition, and the ostium edge as plaque burden 50%. Correct ostial coverage cannot pass both criteria. This is fixable inside pciBench.ts.
2. The screen integration is missing. src/ui/sections/PciBench.tsx is not in this package's list. It still renders EEM area and plaque burden in every mode, does not pass lesion or mode to ImagePanel, lets the step tabs skip the plan, and never resets the plan store. As a result the exam-mode DOM acceptance criterion fails, and on the live bench the goal, reason and blocking features do nothing. This must be routed to the PciBench.tsx owner, or the plan amended.

The minor findings, three of which also need other packages (benchTips raises, the realism facts file, the contrast source), are listed with exact fixes.

rejected: Finding 2 (src/ui/sections/PciBench.tsx wiring: lesion/mode props, slice read-out in exam mode, benchFrameAt main frame, canGo plan block, imagingRuns passed to deploy, plan-store reset on restart/load, gradePlan decisions logged): the finding is correct but PciBench.tsx is not in this package's file list. Not applied here; it needs to go to the PciBench.tsx owner (pci-bench-imaging-unify) or the plan needs amending. The components already take the props: ImagePanel takes lesion and mode, useBenchPlanStore.reset(lesionId) exists, deploy takes {imagingRuns: record.runs.length + 1}, and benchFrameAt(...).lumenMeasurable is there. Until that file changes, the exam-mode 'no plaque-burden read-out before submit' criterion stays unmet.

Finding 7 (src/ui/lab/benchTips.ts raises.events built only from BENCH_LESIONS): correct but out of scope, since benchTips.ts belongs to pci-bench-imaging-unify. The fix for that owner is ALL_BENCH_LESIONS.flatMap(benchCaseEvents) in raises.events, then a rerun of src/content/lab/reachability.test.ts and an update of the waiting.ts entries that become reachable.

Finding 8 (docs/realism/facts entry for the new MODEL PARAMETERS): correct but no facts file is in this package's list. It should go to the facts owner or be added to the plan as docs/realism/facts/pci-bench-measure.md. The entry should list MP_AORTA_LUMEN_MM 30, MP_OCT_OSTIAL_UNCLEARED_MM 5 (resting on the pm-imaging-when-which pitfall 'failing to clear the ostium', for which the module gives no length), MP_TWO_BRANCH_POC_MM 12, MEASURE_TOLERANCE, MP_REFERENCE_WINDOW_MM 10, MP_REFERENCE_PB_MARGIN 0.02, MP_LM_SEGMENT_MM, MP_NO_TAPER_MM 0.25, the severity rule for a stent oversized to the distal reference, and the geometry of the five presets.

fix.notes:
I checked each finding against the code; 5 are fixed and 3 are out of scope. All 122 tests in the 9 files I ran pass, and the typecheck is clean.

Fixed:

1. **Ostial stents (major), src/simulation/pciBench.ts deploy().** The part of the stent inside the aorta (inAorta) no longer counts towards malapposition, expansion, the minimum stent area or perforation. If the stent starts at or before the ostium, there is no coronary proximal edge: proxEdgePB is 0 and no proximal edge dissection is raised. An ostial stent has no proximal reference, so the distal reference stands in for both expansion halves and for the average reference area, as preImaging already does. The result has a new field, ostiumCovered. Ostial lesions get a new criterion, 'Ostium covered (stent reaches the aorta)'; other lesions are unchanged.
   - I added a criterion rather than a new EventKind so that other modules' event handling is untouched.
   - A probe on both ostial presets confirms the fix. A distal-sized stent starting 1 mm in the aorta, or exactly at the ostium, now passes the malapposition and edge criteria. One starting 1 mm inside the ostium fails the ostium criterion and is a geographic miss, with a proximal edge dissection.
   - On aorto-ostial-rca a short stent still fails the expansion criterion because of the unprepared calcium. That is expected.

Compute const showSlice = step === "image" ? run.mode === "guided" && !!planRec?.submitted : run.mode === "guided" || !!result.
